segments.heading: Synthetic generation smoke corpus/Deployment gate

## Deployment gate

A deployment may proceed only when the required independent gate has a current passing result on the exact candidate and basis. A dispatch receipt without a returned result does not satisfy the gate.

segments.heading: Synthetic generation smoke corpus/Reuse and uncertainty
segments.text:
## Reuse and uncertainty

An old passing check may be reused only when an applicable preservation relation establishes its current relevance and covers its material dependencies. An absent dependency edge does not establish non-influence when dependency coverage is incomplete. Preserve that uncertainty and withhold the dependent reuse claim.

segments.heading: Synthetic generation smoke corpus/Permitted representation

## Permitted representation

An author may choose different source-linked record layouts while preserving the stated conditions and unresolved meaning. No representation or shape check supplies semantic acceptance.
